description: Returns the full profile for a specific employee including role, team, clock-in status, and recent activity. Use when the user asks about ONE specific person. Use list_employees for multiple people. Use 'me' as employee_id for the authenticated user's own profile.

employee_id.description: Employee ID (UUID) or 'me' for the authenticated user.

name: get_employee_details

hourly_rate.description: Employee hourly rate. Visible to OwnerAdmin, Admin, and Accountant roles only; null for all other roles. Used for cost calculations.

title: Employee Details
